title: A report about one company says why
blurb: Both inputs produce a comparison now; what was still dishonest was a comparison that did not happen. A lone company arrived with a sentence saying we had searched for the others, whether or not we had — with no engine configured, nothing was asked at all. There are four ways to end up with nobody and a reader acts on each of them differently, so they are four sentences: configure something, name a different company, wait and try again, or accept that this is the answer. Only the last is a statement about a market.
